verdict.rationale: Banking is well covered: Kick connects to 12,000+ banks and cards via Plaid, with a PDF/CSV importer as a fallback. Every synced transaction posts a journal entry to the ledger and is auto-categorized, with rules applied on sync. Payments activity is partly covered through Stripe, Mercury and BILL invoice sync and Ramp/BILL bill sync, and the docs say payroll runs generate journal entries. Missing for 10: any named payroll-provider integration, evidence that Stripe payment/payout activity (not just invoices) syncs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the feeds work.
